items.text: Me.
Calves liver. OMG I hate it so much.

You know, the smiling friendly people behind the front desk are sometimes the highlight of my day. I’ve been struggling with depression for about 6 months and their friendly greetings are so welcome.  

You might not realize how important you are to some of us.

I’m sorry so many people are assholes. You don’t deserve it.
Brilliant!

FWIW, a pellicle is not necessary for making Kombucha - it’s a by product. I start mine with a cup of commercial kombucha (Ness Alla, a Wisconsin brand) and it works great. In fact, I prefer the flavor.

Anything you say will sound like mansplaining. Tread cautiously.

PS - I’m a woman.
Cool! Lucky you!
Thanks!
It does!!
Happy Birthday, beautiful!
I feel the same way! I’m not drinking today either! IWNDWYT!!

I work at an ad agency and we make our clients  get releases for everyone who appears in photos of their businesses. Or at least, we strongly suggest that they do. Here’s a link that summarizes the legalities of using a private person’s likeness in an advertisement: https://www.rocketlawyer.com/article/when-you-need-a-photo-release.rl

OTF studios should probably consider this, even for social media - a business page or feed is basically a series of ads.
No, you should not.
I could have written this myself. It seems pretty hard to get help. Which is amazon, because health insurance costs a fortune.
It’s so weird when you think someone has said something completely shocking, and it turns out you just misunderstood them! 😂😂
You’ll find out. 😉

items.title: Made it through Sunday dinner without a drink.
items.text:
Made it through Sunday dinner without a drink.
We often have the family over and there’s lots of drinks and I usually join in. Tonight I didn’t and I’m looking forward to a good Monday. Thanks for being there, everyone!
Well said! ❤️
What a beautiful dog!
Nice work! That would be tough in the dorms!
I like the extra space on the right, and the double ovens.
I’m so happy for you! My mom passed away about 6 months ago, and I’m still struggling a lot with grief. Also with sobriety. Your post is inspirational!

I’ve struggled with both alcohol and anxiety disorders my whole life and I’m 58, so that’s a while.

One thing that really helps me when my fear is bad is getting some exercise. Like, at least half an hour or an hour of spinning or running. Something so hard it makes me sweat a lot. Also, when I take a studio exercise class the coach’s goofy chatter distracts me from the persistent thoughts that are part of the anxiety.

I wish I could recommend a therapist, but I’m having trouble finding one myself!

I wish you love and peace!
This is peak passive aggressive. Lol.
Also, are those Crocs I see down there? The Fab Five have their work cut out for them. JVN save us!!
This is so cute!!!!
So, so true. Congratulations to you as you successfully move forward!
Great photo!
So satisfying to watch.

You’ll do great and I hope you have fun! For me, the first one or two classes were a little confusing - there’s a little bit of a learning curve for following along.

But the coaches are extremely kind and helpful, so you will be fine 😊!
Second this - you’ll definitely need water and a towel!
Adorbs! And that’s a border collie stare for sure!!
Happy birthday beautiful girl!
Orangetheory Fitness- or any intense cardio workout.
Knock yourself out.

My husband didn’t want a fridge with an ice maker. Finally, about 10 years ago, we got a fridge with ice maker capability, but he didn’t want to pay a plumber $100 to hook it up. We compromised and I called the plumber to hook it up. Game changer.

We didn’t have a TV with a remote until about 15 years ago. To watch TV, our kids would sit about 5 feet from the set and use a 6-foot broom handle to change the channels.

We are not off-the-grid weirdos. We’re both professionals and we live in a suburb of a Midwestern city. But my husband is an old hippie.
Beautiful work!

This is literally how I make kombucha - using a cup of Ness Alla (Wisconsin brand) as a starter. No pellicle.  It turns out great. 

You don’t need the pellicle at all. I throw it away every few batches.
They look like tiny potatoes.
My mom grew up on a farm and told stories of doing this with her brothers and sisters. Thank you for posting this - I always wondered what it looked like!

This is completely familiar! I think the there is something about that time of day - before dinner - that’s just inherently tough. That’s when babies melt down, and people with dementia sundown, and drinkers like me want to get their drink on. I’m trying out the workout thing. Before, I have an apple. 

Best of luck to us both - IWNDWYT!
Knitting, watching TV, drinking LaCroix. IWNDWYT!
Amazing story- thanks for sharing! IWNDWYT!
So. Cute.
Many thanks to our mods, current and new. This is a great sub, and I really appreciate all your thoughtful effort!
Vodka IS the devil! I hope you start feeling better soon. Keep in mind that alcohol withdrawal can be dangerous and please please please thing about seeing a doctor!
Handsome pups!
It’s the eyeliner - gorgeous!
What an excellent, thoughtful reply!❤️
It’s so depressing when that happens. I have stains on my kitchen ceiling that will be there until the next time I paint. My sympathies 🙁.
Great post!
I’ve watched this like 100 times.
